versions.changelog:
Initial public release providing build and deploy orchestration for Alibaba Cloud ECS.

- Enables local build, script injection, and asynchronous deployment to ECS instances via InstallApplication.
- Supports direct deployment by specifying region and instance IDs without requiring project/environment hierarchy.
- Offers dual workflow: standard build+deploy or diagnose+fix+redeploy for troubleshooting failed deployments.
- Enforces mandatory pre-deploy gates (user input, doctor check, verified commands, HITL checklist, wait_ready loop).
- Prohibits auto-discovery of instance information and ensures transparent, user-driven deployment steps.
